description: Edit this sheet of four small chibi pixel art popoto figures (a round potato-like mascot with short arms and feet), each in its own pose: top left standing, top right waving one hand, bottom left holding something up in both hands, bottom right laughing with closed eyes. Turn every figure into the same character, keeping each figure's pose, size, place and round body shape, with the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The character: a kindly old granny popoto who sells clothes, plainly a different popoto from the uncle: no moustache and no hat, soft silver-grey hair gathered in a round bun on top of the head with a wooden hairpin through it, small round half-moon glasses low on the nose, rosy cheeks, a lavender knitted shawl over her shoulders fastened with a small round brooch, a cream apron with a front pocket holding a pair of scissors, and a yellow tape measure hanging around her neck. In the holding-up pose she holds up a small folded pink shirt. Transparent background, nothing else added.
